intended use: SM_Rock_B (flat slab ~3 m) - PRIMARY. Thin layered slab (0.145 x 0.074 x 0.033 m as scanned) -> scale ~x20 for a 3 m slab (1k texture is then ~3 px/cm; fine at gameplay distance). 12.4k tris, game-ready.

tech notes (verified 2026-10-28):
  rock_09_1k.gltf: Blender 5.2 glTF import OK, missing images: 0; 12,416 tris; 1 mesh object(s); bbox (m, X/Y/Z-up) [0.074, 0.145, 0.033]; materials ['rock_09']; textures: rock_09_diff 1024x1024, rock_09_nor_gl 1024x1024, rock_09_rough 1024x1024
  Normal map is OpenGL (+Y) -> tick "Flip Green Channel" in UE. *_arm_1k.jpg packs R=AO, G=roughness, B=metallic (linear, sRGB off).
  Origin is not at base-centre/-Y-front per catalog convention: re-pivot in the dai pipeline.
  Within the ~15k-tri budget as-is (or per object).
